svg.text: Paxos Safety: A New Proposer Must Adopt the Highest-Numbered Accepted Value

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

svg.text: If any acceptor has accepted a value in an earlier round, the new

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

svg.text: proposer is forced to propose that value — not its own. This rule

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

svg.text: is what prevents two rounds from ever choosing different values.

svg.text: Safety rule: among all values returned in Phase-1 promises, the new proposer adopts the one with the highest accepted-round n.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

svg.text: Without this rule, P1's partial accept of "X" + P2's accept of "Y" could let two rounds choose different values.
